<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Each agent has plugins of its own, such as Claude Code's marketplaces. The config's plugins: are in every project; a project adds its own, here or in the chat's Plugins view, and may switch the config's off.

Sources: marketplace:NAME@CATALOG, github:OWNER/REPO[#REF], git:URL[#REF], npm:PACKAGE@VERSION, url:https://….zip[#sha256=…] or path:/absolute; each agent takes some of them.

Plugins are fetched with the agent's own installer, which needs the network: in the sandbox when it has it, else by the app before the sandbox starts. "codeflower plugins fetch" fetches what is missing, also for an isolated sandbox, which reaches only the hosts the installer needs while fetching. A running agent picks up changes when it restarts.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower plugins
```

## Examples

```sh
  codeflower plugins add --agent claude --project study42 marketplace:commit-commands@claude-plugins-official
  codeflower plugins fetch --agent claude --project study42
  codeflower plugins list --agent claude --project study42
```

## Commands

- [`codeflower plugins add`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-add/): Add a plugin to a project; it is fetched before the next start
- [`codeflower plugins disable`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-disable/): Switch a plugin off for a project, also one from the config
- [`codeflower plugins enable`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-enable/): Switch a plugin on for a project
- [`codeflower plugins fetch`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-fetch/): Fetch a project's missing plugins now, with the agent's own installer
- [`codeflower plugins list`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-list/): List an agent's plugins in a project and whether they are fetched
- [`codeflower plugins remove`](/reference/cli/codeflower-plugins-remove/): Remove a project's plugin (the config's are switched off with disable)
